proposed_widenings.name: species_trait / passive_innate family
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has no UnitRecord kind for species traits. UnitRecord is SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — none of which can honestly represent a passive, always-on sensory property with no activation cost, no resource, and no trigger. The taxonomy already has species_trait_root and grant_sense, but neither a SpeciesTraitRecord type nor a mechanics family for passive innate properties exists.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: passive_grant mechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: Even if a SpeciesTraitRecord kind were added, no existing mechanics family fits a permanent, unconditional sense grant. activation (class feature) requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence. on_hit_trigger (mastery) requires a weapon hit. All spell families require casting time and level. A new 'passive_grant' family (no cost, no resource, no trigger, just a permanent effect applied at character creation) is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

notes: Darkvision (Tiefling) is a purely passive, permanent sense grant — no activation, no resource, no trigger, no expiry. The v4 effect atom grant_sense exists and would cover the effect side, but two structural gaps block encoding: (1) no SpeciesTraitRecord kind in UnitRecord, and (2) no passive_grant (or equivalent) mechanics family. Both gaps are consistent with what earlier survey passes noted for other species darkvision traits.
